name: Gästehaus Lukasser
beschreibung:
Framed by rolling meadows and the Kaiser mountains, Gaestehaus Lukasser in Koessen offers a tranquil retreat. Bright rooms and friendly hospitality ensure a carefree mountain getaway.

Lake Walchsee, the Unterberg cable cars in Koessen, and well-groomed cross-country tracks are minutes away.
kurzbeschreibung: Gaestehaus Lukasser in Koessen provides restful accommodation in the scenic Kaiserwinkl region.
